comparatorRouteSelection.basis: The generic 180-EC Pedagogical Sciences target does not name a route. The 2026–27 appendix offers Pedagogy/Educational Sciences and Orthopedagogy; the former broadly retains upbringing, education, family, social development and educational policy, whereas the latter is more specialised in diagnostics and intervention. The four-year primary-school teacher double degree is not the ordinary bachelor route. This choice precedes UCR course selection.

audience.programmeDescription: In the Pedagogy and Educational Sciences route, students study children’s development at home, at school and in the wider community. They evaluate educational and family support and apply research methods in workshops, an internship and a thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The closest UCR combination examines how children develop in families, schools and communities through developmental psychology, youth resilience and empirical research. Groningen adds specialist pedagogy, orthopedagogy, educational assessment and an internship.
